encodedUser.description: Encoded (raw) user of URL, ex. user = 'c3iot'.

encodedPassword.description: Encoded (raw) raw password of URL, ex. password = 'pwd'.

port.description: Port Number of URL, ex. port = 8080. Will null if missing.

encodedQuery.description: Encoded (raw) query of URL (after the `?` mark), ex. 'ion=1&espv=8'. (This will not include the fragment.)

encodedFragment.description: Encoded (raw) fragment of URL (after the `#` mark), ex. 'chapter1'.

title:
URL for "pkg" scheme. This URL represents location of C3 Metadata File. Metadata URLs can *only*
contain following components:

- scheme: "pkg" for current app pkg artifacts.
- host: package name
- encodedPath: folder with the same name as one of valid packages
+ optional  Pkg.Category + encoded sub path for the Pkg.File

E.g. pkg://package/src/path/to/file.c3typ

@see Pkg.Path
@see Url
name: Pkg.Url
